newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African average T-Bill rate 15.70 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.African average T-Bill rate 15.70 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for South African three-month Treasury Bills was unchanged at 15.70 percent at the latest weekly tender, the Reserve Bank said.
Applications for the 800 million rand of bills on offer totalled 1.510 billion rand. The average price was 96.085 rand percent.

The average rate for six-month bills was 15.28 percent from 15.31 percent. Applications for the 300 million rand of bills on offer totalled 785 million rand. The average price was 92.380 rand percent.
